tool: built-in imagegen and manual native mask authoring

headStudy.role: Local generated jaw/skin interior plus the original SW visible jaw contour; all generated facial features, body and other anatomy are unselected.

hairReference.role: Intact native SW bangs, neck lock and visible jaw contour. Head and hair contours are selected into their respective separate layers.

discardedStudies: The initial head-only study shifted the chin; two whole-canvas foreground studies retained the fringe hole and a whole-canvas rear study missed the underlap. These are unselected and are not repo dependencies.

prompts.hairSelection: Restore intact native SW reference bangs and neck-lock contours using the previously authorized manual layer masks. Generated hair study outputs are unselected.
